_note: Roster facts that ship with the code, so they apply to every copy of the site the moment it is deployed (the admin's own changes live in data/roster.json and are added to these). merges: 'alias id' -> 'player id' (one person whose name or number was printed differently on the sheets). transfers: a player moved to a new club. renames: the name the site shows. numbers: a jersey-number rule says that from `from` to `to` (both optional, inclusive) the number `number` of `team` on the sheets is the player `id`: a player who changed number, or a newcomer who took the number of someone who left. `name` is how the newcomer is called when he has no other row.
